title: Cross-Traffic and Traffic Light Warning Features
summary: Feedback in this topic spans rear cross-traffic alerts, traffic light/sign warnings, and real-time traffic information, with clear praise for helpful information features, a few direct complaints about rear cross-traffic warning performance or usability, and many fragments that only mention feature presence, setup, or questions without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the usefulness of real-time traffic information, traffic light details, and the availability of cross-traffic warning features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report rear cross-traffic warning and reverse automatic emergency braking as hard to understand or less sensitive, inaccurate, or inconsistent.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention feature availability, configuration help, purchase or add-on questions, and ambiguous concerns about warning timing or detection distance without a clearly assigned positive or negative sentiment.

limitations: This topic cluster mixes related but distinct subjects, including rear cross-traffic warning, traffic light/sign warning, and navigation traffic information.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing clear customer sentiment beyond the explicitly labeled positive and negative examples.
Some undetermined fragments contain complaint-like wording, but they must remain separate because the supplied sentiment assignment does not label them as negative.
